title: Fix waiver checkout button enablement
body: ## Summary - Remove hidden Section 1/Section 2 waiver checkbox requirements from the checkout waiver dialog. - Keep checkout gated on the fields visible in the dialog: full name, email, and the final agreement checkbox. - Leave the full waiver-signing page’s section checkbox requirements unchanged. ## Review & Testing Checklist for Human - [ ] Re-test the checkout waiver modal with name, email, and final agreement checked; the Proceed to Payment button should become enabled. - [ ] Click Proceed to Payment and confirm it starts Stripe Checkout. - [ ] Confirm the separate waiver signing page still requires its section acknowledgements/signature. ### Notes - Root cause: checkout dialog still required `section1Checked` and `section2Checked`, but those checkboxes were buried in the scrollable waiver body and not visible in your screenshot. - Verified `npm run lint`, `npm run build`, and `npm test`; lint has only existing Fast Refresh warnings. Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/e9b927241a78495e8d9d5325297fcbb1 Requested by: @tbdcmarketing ---
